values: /create-prd wrapper 2026-05-15: PRD-001 — Stripe direct integration on the SHIPPED paywall-blueprint product. Replaces PaywallCheckoutDialog placeholder with real stripe.checkout.sessions.create() flow.
Reference: storage/paywall-providers-research-2026-05-13.md § 8 (Stripe wiring shape; agentic parent repo)

extension_points.notes: Inherited from PRD-000; unchanged in PRD-001. App is still SitecoreAI Full Screen single-page; PRD-001 adds server-side API routes via 4a→4b migration but no new extension points.

operator_attention.item: Stripe Price model: one-time €0.99 lifetime (DQ1→a). Subscription handlers ship forward-compat; adopters who switch to recurring flip the Price in Stripe Dashboard. ADR-0012.
Webhook hosting: migrate scaffold 4a→4b in Tranche A. Webhook handler lives at /api/webhooks/stripe in same Next.js app. ADR-0013.
operator_attention.references: PRD-001 D2 + ADR-0013 + resolves PRD-000 ADR-0005 forward-look

operator_attention.item: Iframe success-return: postMessage primary + 3s/30s polling fallback (parallel race). No pre-PRD-001 probe of Cloud Portal sandbox postMessage permission needed. ADR-0014.
operator_attention.references: PRD-001 D3 + ADR-0014 + resolves research § 8.7 Q3

operator_attention.item: Stripe Customer orphan recovery: `customers.list({email})` + `metadata.tenant_id` filter before create. Resolves PRD-000 Q1 tenantId-durability risk structurally without a real-tenant probe. ADR-0015.
Stripe Tax enabled in Checkout Session config (`automatic_tax: { enabled: true }`); operator toggles Stripe Dashboard per jurisdiction. README documents.

Stripe pre-flight DONE 2026-05-15: Product `prod_UWKcVQmJH2MiSa`, Price `price_1TXHyIAHnDmxitZjwxHhKe8y` (one-time €0.99 EUR), test-mode keys saved to site/.env.local. STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET deferred to Tranche D.
operator_attention.references: Operator action items OA-001-1 through OA-001-5; PRD-001 § 9 Stripe pre-flight

operator_attention.item: Scaffold 4a→4b migration (Tranche A) is mechanical but the regression net is the 74 existing tests + manual real-tenant verify. Allow ~1 day for the migration; existing iframe routes (/, /full-page) MUST keep working.
30-second polling cap (NFR-5) is a guess at Stripe's 95th-percentile webhook delivery. If real-tenant smoke shows >30s lag in test mode, bump to 60s. Configurable via env var.

OA-001-6: Operator decides Stripe Tax Dashboard toggle (enable/disable) for test mode. Code ships with automatic_tax enabled; runtime error if disabled in dashboard. Defer until Tranche C verification or earlier.
OA-001-7: Install Stripe CLI for local webhook listen (`stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/webhooks/stripe`). Required before Tranche D smoke.
OA-001-8: Create real webhook endpoint in Stripe Dashboard pointing at public Vercel/ngrok URL (`/api/webhooks/stripe`). Captures STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET. Required before Tranche D ship.

PRD-001 critical review (standard rigor) produced ~25 findings; operator chose 'follow recommendations' → 11 fixes applied (1 blocker + 4 high + 6 medium). Release plan restructured: Tranche B now includes `checkout.session.completed` event dispatch (was deferred to Tranche D as a release-plan bug). ADR-0014 reframed: polling is primary, postMessage is fastest-path-when-available. NFR-7 documents `/api/entitlement` unauthenticated in v1 with README warning. 6 LOW findings deferred / accepted (CHANGELOG flags + Tranche A commit shape + cold-read inheritance + `/api/portal` 501 status + webhook event ordering + `STRIPE_PRICE_ID` boot validation).

notes: PRD-001 is a feature PRD on the SHIPPED paywall-blueprint product (PRD-000 closed at https://github.com/Chris1415/Sitecore.Plugin.PaywallBlueprint, public, 2026-05-15).
Branched from main (stacked-PRD detection skipped: predecessor PRD-000 merged + closed).

sdk_surface_split: n/a (Stripe is a new SDK surface but the Sitecore SDK heuristic is for Sitecore SDKs specifically; Stripe + Next.js API routes are tracked as PRD-001-internal new surfaces in PRD § 7)
